svg.text: How Google Cloud Lakehouse cross-cloud caching works
Cold Query #1 caches active Parquet column blocks locally; follow-up BI and AI queries verify ACLs and read at local speed

g.text: Query #1: Cold scan (hydrates regional cache once)
Remote cloud storage (AWS S3 / Unity Catalog)
Transfers active column blocks 1x over TLS 1.3 or Private CCI
Queries #2–#6: Warm agent loop ($0 repeat egress)
Runs 5 iterative follow-up SQL & AI.GENERATE queries
Two GA opt-in surfaces (disabled by default · $0 extra Google Cloud fee)
